prompt: Two boards meet a square corner post so that their angles are complementary. If one board sits at $35^\circ$, what is the measure of the other angle, in degrees?
hint: Complementary angles add to $90^\circ$ — a square corner.

hints.text: Complementary angles add to $90^\circ$ — a square corner.

explanation: Complementary angles are two angles whose measures add to $90^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: C comes before S
steps: Complementary comes first in the alphabet and pairs with the smaller total, $90^\circ$ (a Corner).
Supplementary comes later and pairs with $180^\circ$ (a Straight line). Here the corner post makes it $90 - 35 = 55$.
